clips.title: The story
paras: A whiskey-soaked clue sends Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure hunt west from Westfall's shore. The trail leads out across the Great Sea, away from the mainland's troubles, to a remote islet.

Captain Sanders scattered clues along Westfall's coast for any adventurer bold enough to follow them. The last parchment came from the dregs of his favorite whiskey jug and gives the final bearing. The captain's words are clear: head west to the water's edge, then swim out into the waves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure. The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text: Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure! Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore. Once ye get to the water, keep going! Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work. You force the chest open and take the booty.
